_comment: notiwatchd rules. First match wins. match fields: bundle_id (exact, string or array), title/subtitle/body (case-insensitive regex, string or array). Absent field = wildcard. actions: log | ignore | dismiss (reserved) | ntfy | ntfy:phone | ntfy:telegram | exec:<cmd> | webhook:<url>. urgency: normal | high | critical (passed to ntfy -u).
